hypothesis: Keeping the C38 consequence ensemble and C40 ranker family frozen while adding C43's source-disjoint causal train groups raises untouched-final pairwise ranking above60%, beats action-only and C40 by at least5 points, and achieves permutation p<=0.05.
single_variable: Relative to C40, only ranker-training and final source coverage expands: the four C38 consequence checkpoints, temporal architecture, action masking, projections, train-only CV grid, optimizer, shuffled-label controls and absolute promotion thresholds remain fixed.
parent_baseline: C40 consequence fresh pairwise was44/81=54.321%, top1=58.333%, p=0.303297, versus action-only40.741%; C40 failed because absolute accuracy, significance and shuffle-margin gates did not pass.

references.title: FACT failure-aware future and value ranking

architecture.field: frozen action-conditioned future ensemble plus value head
architecture.paper: Predict futures conditioned on candidate actions, then estimate value.
architecture.upstream_code: FACT separates future dynamics and best-of-N value.
architecture.local: Four frozen C38 temporal future-H3 models feed a linear pairwise ranker.
architecture.rationale: H3 hidden deltas replace FACT RGB/video decoder features.

data.upstream_code: Held-out rollout outcomes are excluded from fitting.
data.local: C34 consequence-train plus C43 train sources fit/select; C43 fresh-final sources are evaluated once.
data.rationale: Consumed C34 validation and C33 final are excluded.

action.paper: Consequences condition on executed clean actions.
action.upstream_code: FACT consumes action tokens aligned to future prediction.
action.local: Executed prefix is retained and unexecuted terminal tail is zero-masked.

objective.local: Pairwise logistic linear head; action-only and shuffled-label controls use identical data/optimization.
objective.rationale: Binary LIBERO outcome replaces time-to-go value.

optimization.upstream_code: Value fitting is separate from rollout evaluation.
optimization.local: Five source folds over steps10/30/100 and WD0.3/3/10; LR0.03, projections and tie rule fixed from C40.
optimization.rationale: No fresh-final label selects a setting.

evaluation.paper: Held-out ranking must exceed controls before best-of-N rollout.
evaluation.local: Require pairwise/top1>=60%, +5 points over action-only and C40, p<=0.05, +5 points over 10-label-shuffle mean, train>=75%, all score ranges nonzero.
evaluation.rationale: Only all gates passing authorizes a closed-loop canary.

evidence: C38 corrected checkpoint hashes and C34 dataset hash are hard-coded and rechecked.
Frozen four-member temporal consequence ensemble; linear ranker only.
At least46 train and24 fresh-final mixed groups; source-disjoint roles.
Pairwise outcome objective and all thresholds fixed before C43 outcomes.
Same finite CV, LR, projections and shuffle seeds as C40.
C43 fresh-final evaluated once; no rerun on alternate configs.
H3, C38 ensemble and actions frozen/detached; only linear weights update.

budget.note: Exact train pairs are outcome-dependent and frozen by C44 dataset; each full-pair step is one effective pair epoch, with train-only CV capped at100 steps.

decision.rationale: C40 showed a positive consequence-over-action-only direction but lacked power; C42/C43 expand independent causal sources without changing the model family.
decision.launch_command: After C43 PASS, run bash scripts/h3wam/launch_c44_powered_consequence_ranking.sh once on port32611; do not rerun fresh-final with alternate settings.
